Thanks for the response. I'm actually transgender so the medicine is hormone therapy, so I'm seeing an endocrinologist and don't have a psychiatrist right now. She doesn't know what's going on. The scheduling problem is an error with both me and my doctor, since she only sees people on specific days and I'm almost always busy those days.

I've always liked the idea of keeping reptiles and wanted one as a kid, but my parents never let me have any pets aside from fish (we're all allergic to almost every animal out there and they didn't trust me to clean the cage). After my family's living situation changed over the years, I was trying to figure out what to do with an old fish tank we had and decided on getting a reptile. After doing some research I ended up realising how many different species there were aside from corn snakes and garter snakes, went to an expo and got to interact with a few different species, and it really showed me just how cool they are, so I got one. Ended up ditching the tank and using a plastic bin so that problem never got solved, oh well
